fact: The Caisse Malienne de Securite Sociale pays pensions by mobile payment, which the article calls a success, and is now digitalising bank payment of pensions.
The CMSS pilot of fully digital bank payment of pensions with the Banque de Developpement du Mali was conclusive and is to be rolled out progressively to other partner banks.

The Caisse malienne de sécurité sociale has paid pensions by mobile since 2019, and its application pays pensions below FCFA 50,000 by mobile; a bank-payment pilot with the Banque de Développement du Mali was judged conclusive in July 2026.

The World Bank says Mali is committed to supporting the vulnerable with social payments delivered through an account, and that the Jigisemeyiri Project gave cash transfers to 62,000 food-insecure households during the pandemic.
The World Bank blog says the government's Jigisemejiri safety-net programme piloted mobile money transfers to almost 3,000 households in Mopti in 2021 as an alternative to cash collection.
